# Hunter Bastian

> Interaction design student who designs and builds digital products with calm interfaces, thoughtful motion, and visual restraint.

- Name: Hunter Bastian
- Location: Lehi, Utah
- Site: [hunterbastian.com](https://hunterbastian.com)
- Contact: hunterbastianux@gmail.com
- Studying: B.S. Interaction Design, Utah Valley University (2023–2027)

## Featured

- [Mental Health Mini Site](https://hunterbastian.com/projects/mentalhealth-minisite): UVU student support minisite that puts emergency contacts first, then a searchable directory for counseling, accommodations, and wellness. TypeScript / Next.js / Tailwind / Motion.
- [Lumo](https://hunterbastian.com/projects/lumo): Mindfulness app for calm reflection.
- [AOL redesign](https://hunterbastian.com/projects/aol-redesign): Mobile and desktop email app redesign that modernizes AOL while staying familiar for existing users.
- Studio Alpine: Photography and lifestyle project (founder).
- Studio Cala: Design and web work.

## Background

- Interaction Design undergrad at Utah Valley University; ProdUX at UVU; Dean's List Fall 2024.
- Founder of Studio Alpine (photography and design).
- Video Producer at Catapult — marketing and product video.
- Digital Media Department Representative at UVU — internship support for Web Design and Development students.
- Past: Graphic Design Intern at Nutricost; Digital Design Intern at Clutch.
